title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken Movie: Guren no Kizuna-hen Specials
content:
These two episodes are scenes that were omitted from the movie’s run time, which I honestly don’t know why.

Episode one was a sweet moment where Hiiro and Benimaru and the other dude bond together, sure, I can see that the movie already had a similar scene to this, but still, it had a calmer setting, more silence and clarity for Hiiro. However the second episode was just perfection. Absolute hilarity. I really wish it was included for the comedic effect alone. I always wondered what different races thought about close relatives being used as props, basically, and this was just the kind of nod towards the matter I was looking for.

No need to talk about the sfx and visuals as I have already mentioned them on the movie’s review. This being related so there was no difference between the two.
Overall: 6.66/10.
